title: Bicycles
hook: Peppa 拆掉辅助轮第一次自己骑车，结果光看别人、不看路。

cells.q: What were Peppa and George doing?
cells.a: They were riding their bicycles on a sunny day.
cells.cn: 晴天里他们在骑自行车。

cells.a: Danny, Suzy and Rebecca came. George rode his tricycle.
cells.cn: Danny、Suzy、Rebecca 骑车来了，George 骑的是三轮车。

cells.q: What did Peppa say about George's bike?
cells.a: She said, “George is still riding a baby bike!”
cells.cn: 她说：“George 还在骑宝宝车！”

cells.a: She wished she did not have stabilizers on her bike.
cells.cn: 她希望自己的车不要辅助轮。

cells.a: He took the stabilizers off Peppa's bicycle.
cells.cn: 他把 Peppa 的辅助轮拆了下来。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig ask Peppa?
cells.a: He asked, “Would you like some help, Peppa?”
cells.cn: 他问：“要不要我扶你一把？”

cells.a: Yes! She was riding on her own.
She was not looking where she was going.

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig say at the end?
cells.a: He said, “The important thing is that you are okay.”
cells.cn: 他说：“最重要的是你没事。”
